data.title: 加藤惠 · 礼堂里系好的花束缎带
data.description: 礼堂彩窗旁，惠穿象牙白长袖婚纱，短棕发上覆着简单头纱，贝雷帽已经收起。她低头给花束系紧缎带，抬眼时依旧只是一个很浅的笑，却认真得让这一刻显得格外郑重。
data.action: 系紧花束缎带后抬眼，露出克制而认真的笑。
data.promptProse: Beside the chapel's colored window, Megumi Kato tightens the ribbon around her bouquet, then lifts her eyes with a small earnest smile. A simple veil covers her short brown bob above the opaque ivory bridal gown and long lace-overlay sleeves. The medium view leaves the altar wall and window tracery visible beside her. Reflected stained-glass daylight softly colors the sleeve lace and flowers, with gentle shadows separating her fingers from the knot.
